title: Metrics
description: The metric cascade itself: the 5-second scrape on socrat-0, Thanos blocks on each shelf, node disk, and the hourly thanos-cascade Job. socrat-2 is not part of the cascade.

panels.title: Head series
panels.description: Active time series in the Prometheus head on socrat-0 at the end of the range. This is the live 5-second scrape, before Thanos folds blocks. A gap means Prometheus was not scraped.

panels.title: Sample rate
panels.description: Rate of samples appended to the Prometheus head over 5 minutes. This tracks ingest, not the number of stored blocks. No data means the head metric is missing.

panels.title: Head size
panels.description: Bytes of chunk data held in the Prometheus head. This is the not-yet-finished raw scrape on socrat-0, not the Thanos shelves. No data means the head metric is missing.

panels.title: Local blocks
panels.description: Bytes of finished blocks still in the Prometheus TSDB on socrat-0. Retention there is 12 hours. Zero is normal just after a fresh TSDB. This is not the long archive.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Number of Prometheus scrape targets reporting up at the range end. It counts every job, not only the cascade. No data means Prometheus itself did not answer.

panels.title: Sidecar
panels.description: Whether the Thanos sidecar next to Prometheus can see Prometheus. Up means fresh blocks can be written under /var/lib/socrat-thanos. Down means shipping from socrat-0 has stopped.

panels.title: Last sidecar upload
panels.description: Time since the sidecar last uploaded a block into the raw directory. No data means no successful upload has been recorded yet, which is expected until the first 2-hour block closes. Zero timestamps are hidden.

panels.title: Loaded blocks
panels.description: Blocks the compactors currently have loaded. raw · socrat-0 is the workshop and can hold raw, 5-minute and hourly blocks until they are copied away. 5m · socrat-1 and 1h · socrat-3 are the shelves. Zero means that shelf has no loaded blocks yet. A missing shelf means that compactor is not being scraped.

targets.expr: sum by (shelf) (label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="loaded",pod=~"thanos-compactor-[0-9a-f]+-.+"}, "shelf", "raw · socrat-0", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="loaded",pod=~"thanos-compactor-5m-.+"}, "shelf", "5m · socrat-1", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="loaded",pod=~"thanos-compactor-1h-.+"}, "shelf", "1h · socrat-3", "pod", ".+"))

panels.title: Marked for deletion
panels.description: Blocks on each shelf already marked for deletion and waiting out the delete delay. Marking is not the same as bytes already freed. A missing shelf means that compactor is not being scraped.

targets.expr: sum by (shelf) (label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="marked-for-deletion",pod=~"thanos-compactor-[0-9a-f]+-.+"}, "shelf", "raw · socrat-0", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="marked-for-deletion",pod=~"thanos-compactor-5m-.+"}, "shelf", "5m · socrat-1", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="marked-for-deletion",pod=~"thanos-compactor-1h-.+"}, "shelf", "1h · socrat-3", "pod", ".+"))

panels.title: Compactors
panels.description: Compactor health by shelf. Halted means downsampling or deletion on that shelf has stopped. Running means thanos_compact_halted is 0. A missing shelf means that compactor is not being scraped.

targets.expr: max by (shelf) (label_replace(thanos_compact_halted{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",pod=~"thanos-compactor-[0-9a-f]+-.+"}, "shelf", "raw · socrat-0", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_compact_halted{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",pod=~"thanos-compactor-5m-.+"}, "shelf", "5m · socrat-1", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_compact_halted{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",pod=~"thanos-compactor-1h-.+"}, "shelf", "1h · socrat-3", "pod", ".+"))

panels.title: Loaded blocks
panels.description: Loaded block count on each shelf across the selected range. The raw shelf on socrat-0 includes every resolution still waiting there. Shelves stay at zero until the first blocks are compacted and, for socrat-1 and socrat-3, copied.

targets.expr: sum by (shelf) (label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="loaded",pod=~"thanos-compactor-[0-9a-f]+-.+"}, "shelf", "raw · socrat-0", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="loaded",pod=~"thanos-compactor-5m-.+"}, "shelf", "5m · socrat-1", "pod", ".+") or label_replace(thanos_blocks_meta_synced{job="cattle-monitoring-system/thanos",state="loaded",pod=~"thanos-compactor-1h-.+"}, "shelf", "1h · socrat-3", "pod", ".+"))

panels.title: Blocks still to downsample
panels.description: Blocks on the socrat-0 compactor that are not yet folded to the next resolution. The 5-minute and hourly compactors do not downsample; they only appear here if this metric is present on them. No data means the raw compactor is not scraped.

panels.title: Allowance
panels.description: Soft allowance for cascade data: 22 GiB on socrat-0, 7 GiB on socrat-1, 29 GiB on socrat-3. These are the steady sizes from the cascade plan, not hard quotas. The bar is current metrics bytes divided by that allowance. Green is under 80%, orange from 80%, red at or above the allowance. Data keeps being written past the allowance until the cascade job moves or deletes a block that already has a coarser copy. Left is allowance minus current metrics and can be negative. Disk free is the whole root filesystem. An empty shelf is only the directory itself. Bytes grow when blocks arrive.

targets.expr:
((22 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) * label_replace(vector(1), "node", "socrat-0", "", "")
or (7 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) * label_replace(vector(1), "node", "socrat-1", "", "")
or (29 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) * label_replace(vector(1), "node", "socrat-3", "", "")) - on(node) sum by (node) (socrat_metrics_directory_bytes)

100 * sum by (node) (socrat_metrics_directory_bytes) / on(node) group_left() ((22 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) * label_replace(vector(1), "node", "socrat-0", "", "")
or (7 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) * label_replace(vector(1), "node", "socrat-1", "", "")
or (29 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) * label_replace(vector(1), "node", "socrat-3", "", ""))

panels.title: Metrics bytes
panels.description: Allocated bytes of metrics data on each cascade node. socrat-0 includes the Prometheus TSDB plus raw and work directories. socrat-1 and socrat-3 are the block directories. The directory split is in the table below.

panels.title: Last success
panels.description: When thanos-cascade last finished successfully. The job is scheduled at minute 30 of every hour, Europe/Moscow. The value is a timestamp, so it reads as a time ago. No data means kube-state-metrics has not reported a successful run.

panels.title: Next run
panels.description: Next scheduled start of thanos-cascade. A run that is still going blocks the next one. No data means kube-state-metrics has not reported this CronJob.

panels.title: Active runs
panels.description: How many thanos-cascade Jobs are active now. Idle is the steady state. Running means a copy or cleanup pass is in progress. The policy allows only one at a time.

panels.title: Since last success
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful thanos-cascade run. Yellow after 3 hours, which is also when the shipping alert is allowed to fire. Red after 6 hours. Finished blocks stay on socrat-0 until a later run moves them.

panels.title: Retained jobs
panels.description: Success and failure of thanos-cascade Jobs still kept by Kubernetes. History is the last three successes and three failures, not the lifetime total. A job drops off this graph after it ages out of that history.

panels.title: Job duration
panels.description: How long each retained thanos-cascade Job took, from start to completion. Jobs that have not finished yet are omitted. History is limited to the Jobs Kubernetes still keeps.

panels.title: Sidecar uploads
panels.description: Increase over one hour of block uploads from the Prometheus sidecar into the raw directory, and of upload failures. This is the sidecar shipper, not the hourly copy onto socrat-1 and socrat-3. Flat zero is expected until the first block closes.

panels.title: Directories
panels.description: Each metrics directory the disk collector can see, with the allocated bytes on that directory. prometheus is the local Prometheus volume. raw and work stay on socrat-0. shelf is the block directory on socrat-1 or socrat-3.
